lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\NLDesign\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

lines: 3 uses in 2 files of the public API that is deprecated in Nextcloud 28 to 33. The text of the tag names the replacement where it has one.

The app reads and writes its app config in 3 places and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.
